description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn handed over a `! command`, and the user sent it: Claude Code's bash mode echoes it as a "!" row below the turn's stamp and streams its output there, starting no new turn. The command is the user acting on the hand-over, so the pane no longer needs them (the agent's turn is over, the shell's command is not its work: idle) and the spent command is not offered again (#463).
